observations: Dark green mountain bike with a front suspension fork.
Handlebars with black grips and a central brake lever.
The bike is parked on a concrete surface next to a wall.
A watermark 'DIVINE KELLY' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The drivetrain may be stripped or have internal gear damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the bike being pedaled from a standing position.

risks.risk: The brakes may be non-functional or have internal leaks.
risks.proof: A video of the bike being ridden with the brakes applied.

risks.risk: The rear derailleur may be broken or the cassette may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the rear wheel with the derailleur and cassette visible.

risks.risk: The front suspension may be damaged or stiff.
risks.proof: A video showing the front fork being compressed and released.
risks.if_unproven: as having a stiff or broken fork

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the bike being pedaled to check the drivetrain and brakes.
Photo of the rear wheel with the derailleur and cassette.
Photo of the front suspension being compressed and released.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
